annotation.title_clean: Resolution on the need to undertake a Study on human and peoples' rights and artificial intelligence (AI), robotics and other new and emerging technologies in Africa - ACHPR/Res. 473 (EXT.OS/ XXXI) 2021
annotation.title_en: Resolution on the need to undertake a Study on human and peoples' rights and artificial intelligence (AI), robotics and other new and emerging technologies in Africa - ACHPR/Res. 473 (EXT.OS/ XXXI) 2021
annotation.authors_or_issuer: African Commission on Human and Peoples' Rights (ACHPR)
annotation.summary_en: Resolution of the African Commission on Human and Peoples' Rights (2021) recognising the human rights opportunities and risks of AI, robotics and emerging technologies, and calling for a continental study and a comprehensive human-rights-based governance framework, citing meaningful human control over autonomous weapons.
key_provisions_or_claims: Commits to a study on human and peoples' rights and AI, robotics and emerging technologies in Africa
Calls for a comprehensive governance framework on AI and robotics in Africa
Reaffirms meaningful human control over machine autonomy in the use of force
Stresses equitable distribution of AI benefits and African participation in global governance
Highlights risks of discrimination, privacy violations and disinformation from AI
